skill.name: DataStream Source Creation
skill.description: Reusable workflow for initializing data streams from various sources in Flink: in-memory collections, parallel iterators, generated sequences, or custom connectors. Use when setting up the input stage of a streaming pipeline.
skill.skill_body:
Initialize a DataStream by selecting the appropriate source method:
1. Use fromElements(elements: _*) for small in-memory collections of uniform type.
2. Use fromParallelCollection(SplittableIterator) for parallel iteration over data.
3. Use generateSequence(from, to) for numeric range generation in parallel.
4. Use addSource(sourceFunction) to attach custom sources, such as FlinkKafkaConsumer for external systems.
Verify the data type consistency and that the source is properly configured before returning the initialized DataStream.

## Objective

Initialize and configure data stream sources for pipeline input
## Applicable Signals

- Starting a new Flink DataStream pipeline
- Need to ingest data from in-memory collections
- Need to ingest data from iterators or sequences
- Need to connect to external systems (e.g., Kafka, message queues)

## Contraindications

- Do not use when transforming or filtering already-created streams
- Do not use for mid-pipeline data routing or repartitioning
- Do not use when the data source is already initialized

## Intervention Moves

- Select fromElements for uniform-type collections
- Select fromParallelCollection for iterator-based parallel ingestion
- Select generateSequence for numeric range generation
- Select addSource with appropriate connector for external systems

## Workflow Steps

- Identify the data source type (collection, iterator, sequence, or external system)
- Select the corresponding source creation method
- Configure method parameters (elements, iterator, range, or connector)
- Verify data type consistency
- Return the initialized DataStream object

## Constraints

- All elements in fromElements must be of the same type
- SplittableIterator must specify the data type of returned elements
- generateSequence operates on numeric intervals only
- Custom source functions must implement the appropriate Flink source interface

## Output Contract

- Initialized DataStream object ready for downstream transformations and sinks
